lines.zh: 我在塞尔瑞的金色草地上走向你。
lines.en: I walk toward you across the golden grass of the Shyrelands.

lines.zh: 每一步都不急，反正你跑不过我。
lines.en: No step is hurried; you cannot outrun me anyway.

lines.zh: 我的身体是空的，走起来却很沉。
lines.en: My body is hollow, yet every step lands heavy.

lines.zh: 七十颗心的重量压得草往一边倒。
lines.en: The weight of seventy hearts bends the grass aside.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印追，一步也没落下。
lines.en: I follow your footprints and miss none of them.

lines.zh: 灵魂不用喘气，所以我不停下来。
lines.en: A soul needs no breath, so I never stop.

lines.zh: 风把我的轮廓吹散，我又聚回来。
lines.en: Wind scatters my outline; I gather it back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，让你有时间害怕。
lines.en: I close in slowly, giving you time to be afraid.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的风替我推着这具空壳。
lines.en: The Shyrelands wind pushes this empty shell for me.

lines.zh: 草叶碰到我就凉了半分。
lines.en: Grass blades turn half as warm where I brush them.

lines.zh: 十五点力气，够我走到你面前。
lines.en: Fifteen points of force is enough to reach you.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，直线最省事。
lines.en: I take no detours; the straight line is cheapest.

lines.zh: 我停在光里，像一块晒褪的影子。
lines.en: I stand in the light like a sun-bleached shadow.

lines.zh: 没有心跳可数，我只能数你的脚步。
lines.en: No heartbeat to count, so I count your steps.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞太亮，我的边缘一直在化。
lines.en: The Shyrelands are too bright; my edges keep melting.

lines.zh: 杀了我也没有东西掉，别期待。
lines.en: Kill me and nothing drops, so expect nothing.

lines.zh: 我空手站着，连骨头都是借的。
lines.en: I stand empty-handed, down to borrowed bones.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，不睡觉，只等一个影子。
lines.en: I neither eat nor sleep; I only wait for a shadow.

lines.zh: 风从我肋骨的缝里穿过去。
lines.en: Wind slips through the gaps between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我记得自己也曾有过重量。
lines.en: I remember having weight once.

lines.zh: 这里的光很暖，我却只觉得空。
lines.en: The light here is warm, and I feel only hollow.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，虽然这里从不天黑。
lines.en: I wait for nightfall, though night never comes here.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在草上摊开，又收回来。
lines.en: My outline spreads on the grass, then draws back in.

lines.zh: 谁在我耳边念咒，念的是别人的名字。
lines.en: Someone chants by my ear, spelling another's name.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，草也不敢动。
lines.en: I hold still, and the grass dares not move either.

lines.zh: 你数到三，我就要过来了。
lines.en: Count to three, and I will be on my way.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，又忘了要做什么。
lines.en: I raise my hand, then forget what for.

lines.zh: 草从我身边长出来，穿了过去。
lines.en: Grass grows up around me and passes through.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里没有眼珠。
lines.en: I look up at you with no eyes in my sockets.

lines.zh: 你身上有活人的温度，很刺眼。
lines.en: You carry a living warmth, and it stings.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，那里会跳。
lines.en: I stare at your chest, where something beats.

lines.zh: 你比塞尔瑞的光好看一点。
lines.en: You are a little fairer than the Shyrelands light.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，你后颈会发凉吧。
lines.en: When I look at you, does your neck go cold?

lines.zh: 你的影子被我记住了一次。
lines.en: I have memorized your shadow once.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我讨厌被躲开。
lines.en: Do not look away; I hate being avoided.

lines.zh: 我在你眼睛里找自己的形状。
lines.en: I search your eyes for my own shape.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，我就靠近了一寸。
lines.en: You blinked, so I advanced an inch.

lines.zh: 你这副身板，值得我走一趟。
lines.en: A frame like yours is worth the walk.

lines.zh: 我看你，是在量到你面前的步数。
lines.en: I look at you to measure the steps between us.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在我听来像倒计时。
lines.en: Your breathing sounds like a countdown to me.

lines.zh: 我认得活人看我时的那种眼神。
lines.en: I know that look the living give me.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我可不觉得好笑。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? I find nothing funny.

lines.zh: 你砍开我，里面只有风。
lines.en: You cut me open and find only wind inside.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，但很快就漏光了。
lines.en: There is pain, but it leaks away quickly.

lines.zh: 你削掉我一层，我又长回来。
lines.en: You shaved off a layer, and I grow it back.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不会流血，只会发白。
lines.en: My wounds do not bleed; they just turn white.

lines.zh: 你以为切开了什么？什么也没有。
lines.en: What did you think you cut open? Nothing.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，只是懒得挨第二下。
lines.en: I shift half a pace, merely unwilling to take a second hit.

lines.zh: 砍得不错，可惜我不靠这个活。
lines.en: A fine cut, but I do not live by such things.

lines.zh: 我散了一半，另一半还在看你。
lines.en: Half of me scattered; the other half still watches.

lines.zh: 这具壳挨打时声音很闷。
lines.en: This shell makes a dull sound when struck.

lines.zh: 别停手，我想看看能撑到哪。
lines.en: Do not stop; I want to see how far this holds.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，是把我当牲口吗。
lines.en: You hold out food; do you take me for livestock?

lines.zh: 我没有胃，你的面包白举了。
lines.en: I have no stomach; your bread is wasted.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我吃的是别的东西。
lines.en: Put it away; I feed on something else.

lines.zh: 用糖引我，你该去糖果维度。
lines.en: Lure me with sweets and you belong in Candyland.

lines.zh: 面包的香气绕过我，去找活人。
lines.en: The smell of bread goes around me, toward the living.

lines.zh: 你想喂我，我只想靠近你一点。
lines.en: You mean to feed me; I only mean to come closer.

lines.zh: 别晃那堆吃的，晃得我烦。
lines.en: Stop waving that food; it irritates me.

lines.zh: 我若真饿了，你手里那点不够。
lines.en: If I were truly hungry, that handful would not do.

lines.zh: 你把诱饵放低些，我好踩过去。
lines.en: Lower your bait so I can step over it.

lines.zh: 我不为食物走，只为走近你。
lines.en: I do not walk for food, only to get nearer you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞进一桶冷水。
lines.en: You hit me like walking into a bucket of cold water.

lines.zh: 我的身体没有阻力，你却退开了。
lines.en: My body offers no resistance, yet you recoil.

lines.zh: 别推，我本来就要贴着你走。
lines.en: Do not shove; I meant to walk against you.

lines.zh: 擦过一下，你的手臂会麻很久。
lines.en: One brush and your arm will stay numb a while.

lines.zh: 我比看起来更硬，也更冷。
lines.en: I am harder and colder than I look.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的边缘，带走一点凉。
lines.en: You pass through my edge and carry off some chill.

lines.zh: 让开或不让开，我都会过去。
lines.en: Whether you yield or not, I will pass.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，你就欠我一件事。
lines.en: Touch me once and you owe me a favor.

lines.zh: 我这具壳不重，撞起来却实。
lines.en: This shell is light, yet it strikes solid.

lines.zh: 你贴这么近，是想先动手吗。
lines.en: Standing this close, are you striking first?

lines.zh: 繁殖这种事，早就不属于我了。
lines.en: Breeding is long behind me.

lines.zh: 我没有血脉可传，只有这身空壳。
lines.en: No bloodline to pass on, only this empty shell.

lines.zh: 你找错对象了，我连心都没有。
lines.en: Wrong creature to ask; I have no heart at all.

lines.zh: 灵魂不生灵魂，我们只会消散。
lines.en: Souls do not birth souls; we only fade.

lines.zh: 别凑过来，我身上没有温度。
lines.en: Do not lean in; there is no warmth on me.

lines.zh: 我这具身体是捡来的，不能生养。
lines.en: This body was scavenged and cannot bear young.

lines.zh: 同族相见也只是互相穿过。
lines.en: Kin meeting kin merely pass through each other.

lines.zh: 没有后代，所以我不怕死。
lines.en: No offspring, so death holds no threat.

lines.zh: 你想要的，我给不了半分。
lines.en: What you want, I cannot give a fraction of.

lines.zh: 走开吧，我对活物没有那种兴趣。
lines.en: Go away; I hold no such interest in the living.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我连自己都拿不稳。
lines.en: I pick nothing up; I can barely hold myself.

lines.zh: 地上那些，留给活着的人吧。
lines.en: Leave the things on the ground to the living.

lines.zh: 我的手能穿过石头，抓不住物件。
lines.en: My hands pass through stone and grip no object.

lines.zh: 捡了也没处放，我没有口袋。
lines.en: No use picking it up; I have no pockets.

lines.zh: 你要那堆掉落物？尽可以拿。
lines.en: You want those drops? Take them all.

lines.zh: 我死后什么也不留，现在也一样。
lines.en: I leave nothing when killed, and nothing now.

lines.zh: 我试着握过一枚符文，它掉了。
lines.en: I once gripped a rune; it fell straight through.

lines.zh: 物件对我是透明的，我对它也是。
lines.en: Objects are transparent to me, as I am to them.

lines.zh: 别指望我替你捡，我碰不到。
lines.en: Do not expect me to fetch it; I cannot touch.

lines.zh: 我空手来，也打算空手走。
lines.en: I came empty-handed and plan to leave so.

lines.zh: 找到你了，别装作没看见。
lines.en: Found you; do not pretend you missed me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步停在那里，就是答案。
lines.en: Your steps stopped right there, and that is answer enough.

lines.zh: 我看中你了，这是你的运气。
lines.en: I have chosen you; consider it your luck.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我该动身了。
lines.en: The distance is right, so I will set off.

lines.zh: 整个塞尔瑞，我只认这一个目标。
lines.en: All the Shyrelands, and I claim only this one target.

lines.zh: 你刚才回头，我就锁定了你。
lines.en: You glanced back, and I locked on.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来我会更高兴。
lines.en: Do not run; running would please me more.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的热气了。
lines.en: I have caught the heat coming off you.

lines.zh: 一具空壳，只追一个活人。
lines.en: One hollow shell, and only one living soul to chase.

lines.zh: 我盯上的人，从来不走空。
lines.en: My marks never come up empty.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，等于递上了名字。
lines.en: Standing there, you have handed me your name.

lines.zh: 你被我挑中，跑也没用。
lines.en: You are my pick, so running gains you nothing.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能碰到你了。
lines.en: A little closer and I can touch you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，你别退太快。
lines.en: I press on step by step; do not retreat too fast.

lines.zh: 十五点，落在你身上刚刚好。
lines.en: Fifteen points will land on you just right.

lines.zh: 我算着步数，你还剩三步。
lines.en: I am counting steps; you have three left.

lines.zh: 你在往左躲，我看见肩膀动了。
lines.en: You dodge left; I saw the shoulder twitch.

lines.zh: 我不用喘气，所以追得比你久。
lines.en: I never gasp for air, so I can chase longer.

lines.zh: 这具空壳不累，你的腿会累。
lines.en: This empty shell does not tire; your legs will.

lines.zh: 别往高处爬，我不会放弃。
lines.en: Do not climb high; I will not give up.

lines.zh: 我瞄着你的膝弯，那处最好下手。
lines.en: I aim at the back of your knee, the easiest place to strike.

lines.zh: 你在数我的心跳，可惜没有。
lines.en: You are counting my heartbeat; there is none.

lines.zh: 我贴在光里，你分不清哪个是我。
lines.en: I cling to the light; you cannot tell which part is me.

lines.zh: 你一犹豫，我就又近了一寸。
lines.en: One hesitation, and I gained another inch.

lines.zh: 终点是你，路只有一条。
lines.en: The destination is you, and there is only one road.

lines.zh: 这一下十五点，你记住了。
lines.en: Fifteen points on this strike; remember it.

lines.zh: 护甲挡不住一只没有骨肉的手。
lines.en: Armor does not stop a hand with no flesh on it.

lines.zh: 别喊，我听过太多人喊。
lines.en: Do not scream; I have heard too many scream.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就补上一步。
lines.en: You step back half, and I fill the step.

lines.zh: 我的力气是借来的，用着正好。
lines.en: My strength is borrowed, and it serves well.

lines.zh: 这一击不重，但我不会只打一次。
lines.en: The blow is light, but I will not strike only once.

lines.zh: 你的血是热的，我指尖凉了。
lines.en: Your blood is hot; my fingertips went cold.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候，自己也散了一点。
lines.en: Striking you scatters a little of me too.

lines.zh: 七十颗心的身体，换你一下不亏。
lines.en: A seventy-heart body trading one hit is no loss.

lines.zh: 腿软了？十五点还没使完。
lines.en: Knees buckling? I have not spent all fifteen points.

lines.zh: 我从塞尔瑞的光里被挤出来。
lines.en: I am squeezed out of the Shyrelands light.

lines.zh: 睁眼就是草地，还有活人的气味。
lines.en: I open my eyes on grass and the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 我又被放进这个世界了，真烦。
lines.en: I have been put into this world again; how tedious.

lines.zh: 这具身体刚成形，还在抖。
lines.en: This body just formed and is still trembling.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫来的，站出来。
lines.en: Whoever called me here should step forward.

lines.zh: 光太亮，我花了很久才看清轮廓。
lines.en: The light is too bright; my outline took long to settle.

lines.zh: 新的躯壳，旧的空。
lines.en: A new shell, the same old emptiness.

lines.zh: 我一出生就知道该往哪走。
lines.en: I knew which way to walk the moment I formed.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的风先认出了我。
lines.en: The Shyrelands wind recognized me first.

lines.zh: 我数了数，还是七十颗心。
lines.en: I counted, and it is still seventy hearts.

lines.zh: 落地时我几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I landed with almost no sound at all.

lines.zh: 这次我要走得更慢一点。
lines.en: This time I intend to walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 别急着打招呼，我先找目标。
lines.en: Do not greet me yet; I look for a target first.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，还是空着手。
lines.en: I am back, and still carrying nothing.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的边缘，卷起一圈白烟。
lines.en: Fire licks my edges and curls up white smoke.

lines.zh: 落地时我摔成一片薄雾，又聚起来。
lines.en: I hit the ground as thin mist and gathered again.

lines.zh: 水把我冲淡了，我尝起来像铁。
lines.en: Water thins me out; I taste of iron now.

lines.zh: 气浪把我撕开，我在半空重新拼好。
lines.en: The blast tears me apart; I reassemble in the air.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我身上，像钉进一面旗。
lines.en: The arrow pins me like a nail through a banner.

lines.zh: 那股魔力在我体内打了个结。
lines.en: That magic tied a knot inside me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是这具空壳。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet this empty shell goes hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光穿过我，把我照得通透。
lines.en: Lightning passes through and makes me transparent.

lines.zh: 虚空把我按下去，我却又浮上来。
lines.en: The void presses me down, and I float back up.
